articles.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
articles.snippet: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

articles.title: The pile of lawsuits against Kalshi just grew by one
articles.snippet: Arkansas has accused the prediction market of running illegal gambling, joining Utah and several other U.S. states that have filed criminal or civil charges.

articles.title: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike
articles.snippet: From setting up an SMSF or a company, to just leaving the country entirely, here are some strategies Australian Bitcoiners can employ to deal with 2027’s massive CGT hike.

articles.title: S&P 500 Plunges, Wall Street Fears Circuit Breaker, Just One Day After Trump Celebrated Record Highs
articles.snippet: A day after Trump celebrated stock market records, the S&P 500 sank 3.8%, putting emergency trading halts in focus as AI stocks dragged Wall Street sharply lower during Thursday trading.

articles.title: Why Bitcoin's Next Soft Fork Could Feel Like a Practice Run
articles.snippet: Matt Corallo explains why patching four legacy bugs is about rebuilding muscle memory, just as much as it’s about Bitcoin maintenance.
